shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' | sed -n '1,120p' && printf '\\n--- root manifests ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'README*' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- next config ---' && cat next.config.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- app files ---' && find app -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sh -c 'echo \"--- "'$1"; sed -n "1,240p" "$1"'"' _ {} \\; && printf '%s\\n' '--- git status/log ---' && git status --short && git log --oneline -5"
/bin/bash -lc "find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,240p' {} \\; && printf '\\n--- baseline build ---\\n' && npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- prerendered shell markers ---' && rg -o 'Dashboard|Total Revenue|Revenue|Latest Invoices|skeleton-[a-z-]+' .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c || true && printf '%s\\n' '--- diff stat ---' && git diff --stat && printf '%s\\n' '--- diff check ---' && git diff --check && printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---' && git status --short && printf '%s\\n' '--- numbered files ---' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,220p' && nl -ba app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git checkout -- tsconfig.json && git status --short && git diff --check'
